The '''2018 Copa Sudamericana second stage''' was played from 17 July to 16 August 2018.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2018_cla_cs.pdf|title=EL CALENDARIO DE AMBOS TORNEOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2018 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2018 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2018-espanol_0.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the second stage was held on 4 June 2018, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/el-4-de-junio-se-sortean-los-octavos-de-la-libertadores-y-segunda-fase-de-la-sudamericana|title=El 4 de junio se sortean los Octavos de la Libertadores y Segunda Fase de la Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=19 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/los-cruces-de-la-segunda-fase|title=Los duelos de la Segunda Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=4 June 2018}}</ref> For the second stage, the teams were allocated to two pots according to their previous results in this season:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-sudamericana-2018-sistema-de-sorteo-segunda-fase|title=CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2018, SISTEMA DE SORTEO – Segunda Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=31 May 2018}}</ref>
*'''Pot 1:''' 10 teams transferred from the Copa Libertadores and six best winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana
*'''Pot 2:''' 16 remaining winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana

The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties (O1–O16) between a team from Pot 1 and a team from Pot 2, with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could be drawn into the same tie.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/pauta_sorteo_2018_sudamericana.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2018, SISTEMA DE SORTEO – Segunda Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the second stage, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] would be used. If still tied, [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] would not be played, and the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 27).<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the second stage advanced to the [[2018 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2018 Copa Sudamericana final stages|knockout stages]].<section end=Format />

==Matches==
The first legs were played on 17–19, 25–26 July, and 1–2 August, and the second legs were played on 24, 31 July, 1–2, 7–9 and 14–16 August 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/fixture-de-la-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=Fixture de la Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 June 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_2018_sudamericana_segunda_fase_circular.pdf|title=FIXTURE SUDAMERICANA - SEGUNDA FASE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
